checked_opt_in: Host registers immutable TribesVirtualMemoryBackend targets before external-call target freeze and before any VM reservation. Native-only mode retains its subpage rejection.
checked_transactions: VM ownership mutex serializes region metadata. Trusted backend holds memory-access write lock across native group permission changes, zero-fill of newly committed logical pages, and logical permission publication. All other pages in each native group retain their protection and bytes.
commit: Newly committed pages are zero-filled even for PAGE_READONLY or PAGE_NOACCESS. Classic and FromApp recommit preserve existing protection and contents. NT recommit changes protection and retains contents.
decommit: Clear only the requested logical page states. Do not madvise partial native groups. Recommit zero-fills decommitted pages. Full release denies checked/native access before MADV_DONTNEED and metadata removal.
query: Committed/reserved runs follow 4 KiB state in checked mode. Native tail padding is retained as owned reserved space, not made available to another allocation.
failure: Publish region-state bytes only after successful backend transaction. Rollback native protections on OS failure; fail closed if rollback fails. Failed zero-fill transactions can change only formerly inaccessible uncommitted bytes.
scope: Existing allocation modes and bounded address-requirement handling
No new executable-memory allocation, PAGE_GUARD, large pages, placeholders, remote process, Windows SEH, or dynamic VirtualProtect support
nested_access: Nested explicit/compiler-generated read brackets share one outer OS read lock per native thread, checking every inner range. A queued permission writer waits for all brackets to end. Publication inside a live read bracket fails closed instead of attempting lock upgrade.
